description: Fetch a single ticket by id, with its subject, status, assignment, requester, labels, custom fields, SLA state and timing. A merged ticket redirects to the ticket it was merged into. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/tickets/{id}.

include.description: Comma-separated related object types to side-load into the response's `linked` section, e.g. person,agent,department,organization.

name: deskpro_get_ticket
title: Get one ticket
